subject: Inbound demo request — use case + launch timeline
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@marketly.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo? evaluating for summer launch

Hi Olga —

I signed up for Redwood yesterday (self-serve) and our lead engineer suggested we get a short walkthrough to confirm perf for our embed/search pipeline. Main things we want to cover: expected latency for 1–5k QPS mock, cost estimates for embeddings at scale, and any guidance on light quantization options. Planning to ship an internal beta late September — can you help with a 30-min demo next week?

A bit about us: Marketly builds product search for SMB retailers, ~20M active SKUs, goal is to cut search latency during peak holidays. I can pull together a small traffic sample if that helps.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Engineering, Marketly
sam.patel@marketly.ai
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@marketly.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo? evaluating for summer launch

Hi Sam — thanks for signing up and for the context. Happy to run a focused 30-min session. Before I lock time with the engineering team, two quick qualification items so we tailor the demo and bring the right folks: 

1) Traffic profile — do you expect 1k–5k QPS sustained or bursts during peak windows? any average tokens per request estimate?
2) Timeline — you mention late September beta; is that a hard launch date or a soft goal?
3) Data sensitivity — will any PII or regulated data be included in the sample? (we can redact or use a synthetic sample)
4) Success criteria — what would make the demo a win for you (latency threshold, cost per query, integration guidance)?

If you can reply with short answers, I’ll propose three slots and loop in Ben (solutions engineer) for perf questions and Priyom (SDR) for meeting logistics. If you already have a traffic CSV, feel free to attach — we often use a small sample to run rough throughput projections (CSV format ok).

Proposed participants: Olga (you), Ben (solutions), Sam (Marketly), Priya (if product PM available).

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@marketly.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Singh <psingh@marketly.ai>
Date: 2025-08-17T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo? evaluating for summer launch

Thanks Olga — answers below, and attaching a tiny sample we exported: usage_snapshot.csv (first 500 rows).

1) Profile: expecting bursts up to ~3k QPS during peak windows (holiday tests). Typical steady midweek traffic ~200–400 QPS. Average tokens per request ~220.
2) Timeline: late September is a fairly firm deadline — internal beta clients are lined up 9/22; we’d like production by early November.
3) Data: no regulated data in the sample; product titles/descriptions only. We will redact any customer PII.
4) Success criteria: demo is a win if we see a path to 95th percentile latency <120ms for embedding + search flow and a clear cost projection for 50M embeddings/month.

Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 47KB)

—Sam
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@marketly.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo? evaluating for summer launch

Great, thanks for the quick details and the sample — that’s perfect. I’ve reviewed the CSV briefly and attached it to our ticket (HS-987654) for Ben to pre-check for throughput assumptions.

Here are three 30-minute options (all PST):
- Tue 8/19 10:00–10:30
- Wed 8/20 14:00–14:30
- Thu 8/21 09:00–09:30

Please pick a slot or share a 30-min window that works and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda: 1) 10-min perf expectations, 2) 10-min cost/quantization tradeoffs, 3) 10-min next steps (pilot options + infra).

Ben — can you skim the attached sample and flag anything we should pre-warn Marketly about on the call?

Priyom — I’ll hand this one to you for follow-up and invite management.

Thanks — look forward to the call.

Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv (CSV)
